# Meal planner

## Destination

Plan a week of meals from the recipes already in the box.

## Notes

Recipes are the household's own; keep everything offline.

## Decisions so far

<!-- the index: one line per closed ticket -->

- [Where recipes are stored](issues/01-recipe-storage.md): recipes stay in markdown files.
- [Nutrition labels](issues/06-nutrition-labels.md): no nutrition data for now.

## Not yet specified

- **Seasonal menus**: whether the planner suggests by season.
- How leftovers carry over.

## Out of scope

- Shopping delivery.
